steps.action: Filter listings and view spatial map intelligence.

steps.action: Enter the private transaction workspace with owner/broker.

steps.action: Submit formal purchase price and terms.

steps.action: View current property listings and performance metrics.

steps.action: Configure property details, unit types, pricing, and amenities.
